:::{#def-fold-mse}
#### Fold mean squared error

The **fold mean squared error** $\foldmse{\ifold}$ of [fold](#def-folds) $\fold{\ifold}$
is the [mean squared error](prediction.qmd#def-prediction-mse)
of the [fold-out rule](#def-fold-out-rule)'s predictions
for the $\foldsize{\ifold}$ ([fold size](#def-fold-size)) observations in that fold:

$$
\foldmse{\ifold} \eqdef \frac{1}{\foldsize{\ifold}} \sum_{\iobs \in \fold{\ifold}} \sqf{\fittedwo{\ifold}{\predvar_{\iobs}} - \outvar_{\iobs}}.
$$ {#eq-fold-mse}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
#### Source

@james2021islr2e [sec. 5.1.3], who write the fold mean squared errors as
$\text{MSE}_1, \ldots, \text{MSE}_{\nfolds}$.
:::

:::
